channel.title: Wire — Node.js
channel.description: Node.js from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Your Dashboard Was Fine at 10K Rows. Not at 10M
item.description: Create a free Tiger Cloud account and get $1,000 in credit for 30 days. No credit card required. Fully managed PostgreSQL that scales effortlessly. (4 sources: frontendfocus, golangweekly, nodeweekly, rubyweekly)

item.title: Your Trace Shows the Slow Span. Not the Exception
item.description: The OtlpIntegration bridges OTel traces and Sentry errors. Keep your OTel setup, add Sentry for errors, and see both in one trace waterfall. (1 source: nodeweekly)

item.title: Detecting SQLite Full Table Scans in Node.js
item.description: Back in July, Aaron Patterson wrote about detecting full table scans with SQLite. The trick is that you don’t need EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN for this. (1 source: nodeweekly)

item.title: Rewriting a Node.js Service in Go with AI Agents
item.description: How Checkly rewrote a Node.js service handling 92M messages a day into Go using AI agents, and the test harness that made it safe to ship. (2 sources: golangweekly, nodeweekly)

item.title: Workers vs Processes in Node
item.description: Where worker threads fit beside async I/O, libuv's thread pool, and child processes for CPU-bound JavaScript work. (1 source: nodeweekly)

item.title: a proposal to remove dual ESM/CJS code samples in the API docs
